description: Systematic inventory of qualified evidence sources for Commander Studio (P0 Deliverable 1).

sources.title: Scryfall Bulk Manifest & Oracle Cards
sources.observation_period: All released MTG sets through November 2026
sources.coverage_scope: 100% of all MTG cards; 801 / 801 format- and color-legal Chulane cards
sources.double_counting_risk: None; cards fold strictly 1:1 to canonical oracle_id across printings.
sources.license_terms: Scryfall API Terms: free personal / non-commercial use with fan content attribution; no AI training.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET (daily manifest, conditional ETag requests; generic User-Agent and Accept headers required; strip price fields on write; no single-card polling loop).
bias_risks: Facts and mechanics, no evaluation of gameplay strength or deck fit
Scryfall Tagger roles are subjective community classifications and not authoritative Oracle facts
sources.status_rationale: Fully verified daily bulk dataset imported into studio.sqlite3 (scryfall_card, 35,353 cards); covers 801 / 801 legal Chulane cards.

sources.title: Playgroup.gg Card Atlas & Gameplay Research
sources.coverage_scope: Subset of cards actively cast in Playgroup Live games
sources.double_counting_risk: Pod clustering: repeated games by the same local playgroups skew frequencies; paper games tracked without digital card logging lack card events.
sources.license_terms: Aggregated statistics CC BY 4.0 with attribution and link; public API explicitly permits scraping and bulk access; authenticated raw-games endpoint excluded.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Public API / HTML GET with recognizable generic User-Agent (400 req/min with UA, 10 req/min without; max 20 requests/10 min per commander path; respect 429 Retry-After; CC BY 4.0 attribution with link required).
bias_risks: Observed correlations are NOT causal proof of card efficacy
Survivorship bias: drawn-to-played measures only cards drawn in surviving game states
Pilot- and pod-clustering bias
Missing long-tail coverage: cards with few live appearances remain completely unobserved
sources.status_rationale: Public API permits bulk access with generic User-Agent and CC BY 4.0 attribution; Card Atlas itself is HTML (/cards/...) with survivorship and pod-clustering biases, so data quality remains REVIEW.

sources.title: Playgroup.gg Chulane Commander Performance
sources.observation_period: Aggregated live games through November 2026 (~2,094 recorded games)
sources.schema_format: Public REST API / HTML Web Page
sources.coverage_scope: Chulane cards with sufficient live appearances in Playgroup Live
sources.double_counting_risk: Repeated matches of the same deck/pilot combination in a recurring playgroup.
sources.license_terms: CC BY 4.0 for aggregated commander statistics with attribution and link; public API explicitly permits bulk access.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Public API GET with recognizable generic User-Agent (400 req/min with UA, 10 req/min without; max 20 requests/10 min per commander path; respect 429 Retry-After; CC BY 4.0 attribution with link required).
bias_risks: Seat position skew: Seat 1 shows 45.3% winrate (674 games), Seat 5 shows 16.3% (43 games)
Archetype skew: Playgroup Chulane population is heavily Landfall-focused
Small sample sizes for non-staple cards (n < 30)
sources.status_rationale: Public API permits bulk access with generic User-Agent and CC BY 4.0 attribution; Chulane winrate (36%) and card lifts remain REVIEW due to heavy pilot, seat-position, and archetype confounding.

sources.title: EDHREC Chulane Recommendations & Relative Lift
sources.observation_period: Two-year rolling window of online decklists (Archidekt, Moxfield)
sources.coverage_scope: Top ~1,300 cards appearing in online Chulane decks; long-tail (<1%) omitted
sources.double_counting_risk: Thematic and budget subviews overlap with the main commander page; must never be summed across cohorts.
sources.license_terms: EDHREC Terms of Service (effective 2024-08-06): personal non-commercial viewing only; automated queries, scripts, and downloading are prohibited; robots.txt disallows /deckpreview/.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: PROHIBITED_AUTOMATED_RETRIEVAL (ToS effective 2024-08-06 prohibit automated queries/scripts; robots.txt disallows /deckpreview/; json.edhrec.com/robots.txt returns HTTP 403; historical snapshots only, no new automated fetches).
bias_risks: Popularity bias: deckbuilding presence != gameplay strength or winrate
Lift is relative deck co-occurrence, NOT winrate lift!
Echo-chamber bias: popular precons and internet lists dominate builder selections
sources.status_rationale: Data quality VERIFIED for 20 SHA-256-verified historical snapshots from 2026-11-11 (Run #43024442970, Refs #1186; 1,304 legacy rows remain retrieved_at_utc=NULL). Automated retrieval is separately classified access_status=prohibited per ToS (2024-08-06).

sources.title: Commander Spellbook Combo Variants (Bulk Export)
sources.schema_format: JSON Bulk (variants.json.gz) / JSON REST API (sparse only)
sources.coverage_scope: All known and rule-verified MTG combos matching Chulane color identity (Bant / WUG)
sources.double_counting_risk: Redundant combo variants (e.g. same loop with different bounce targets) must not be counted as independent strength claims.
sources.license_terms: MIT License (backend source code); combo dataset license unconfirmed on operator pages (attribution with link requested).
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET via https://json.commanderspellbook.com/variants.json.gz (no full export via REST API; REST only for sparse unauthenticated requests at ~80 req/min respecting HTTP 429; backend.commanderspellbook.com/robots.txt disallows crawlers; strip price/salt fields).
bias_risks: Existence of a combo is NOT proof of consistency, speed, resilience or in-game winrate
Complex 4+ piece combos are rarely executed in real games
sources.status_rationale: Operator-recommended bulk export (variants.json.gz) for full combo data; REST API is sparse-only. Processed deterministically via scripts/spellbook_combos_fetch.py (bulk mode) and scripts/build_spellbook_shells.py.

sources.title: Curated Chulane 99-Card Deck Corpus (Repository Archive)
sources.coverage_scope: Canonical Chulane decklist corpus in repository (10,551 raw / 10,150 deduplicated decks; initial 975-deck ACTIVE archive superseded)
sources.double_counting_risk: Content duplicates resolved via canonical oracle_id fingerprint at import time.
sources.license_terms: Project research dataset under AGENTS.md §12 (2026-11-15 relaxation; purchase/price signals excluded for Chulane).
bias_risks: Corpus reflects historical collection choices and specific community deck sources
Null-case trap: unobserved pool cards (0 hits) mean unobserved, never weak
sources.status_rationale: Canonical Chulane decklist corpus stored in-repo under data/research/chulane_corpus/ (replaces historical non-existent local:data/hub/ reference) and imported into studio.sqlite3.

sources.title: cEDH Tournament Placement & Competitive Meta
sources.double_counting_risk: Same player entering sequential tournaments with minor card swaps.
sources.license_terms: EDHTop16 terms: API as-is, no excessive automated requests, no redistribution without permission, no documented rate limit; TopDeck.gg API v2 requires Owner API key, attribution with link, no scraping outside API, no storing player names.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: EDHTop16: unclear (no documented rate limit); TopDeck.gg: API v2 only with Owner key (5/50/100 req/min by tier, attribution required, omit player names).
bias_risks: Extreme selection bias: cEDH optimizes for turn 2-3 wins and fast mana incompatible with casual play
Very low sample size for Chulane in current competitive tier lists
sources.status_rationale: Valuable supplementary perspective, but requires manual audit due to cEDH selection divergence and undocumented EDHTop16 rate limits.

sources.title: XMage Engine Card Facts & Rules Support
sources.observation_period: All cards implemented in the canonical pinned XMage Rules Core (7,231 verified cards)
sources.coverage_scope: 7,231 cards implemented in pinned XMage engine; 801 / 801 legal Chulane cards have verified readiness
sources.double_counting_risk: None; card names map deterministically to engine implementations.
bias_risks: Engine implementation coverage differs from full Oracle card universe
Tactical card mechanics without external decision control fail closed
sources.status_rationale: 100% verified locally against pinned engine rules. All 801 legal Chulane pool cards are qualified with sim_status=OK.

sources.title: Scryfall Tagger Functional Roles & Oracle Tags Bulk
sources.observation_period: Continuous community tag catalog (official Oracle Tags bulk)
sources.schema_format: JSONL Bulk (Scryfall Bulk oracle_tags, official bulk export)
sources.coverage_scope: Community functional tags: ramp, draw, removal, bounce, tutor, combo-piece
sources.double_counting_risk: Multiple overlapping tags for the same functional role (e.g. bounce-creature and bounce-permanent).
sources.license_terms: Scryfall API Terms: free non-commercial / research use with fan content attribution; official Oracle Tags bulk.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET via Scryfall Bulk Data API (type: oracle_tags) with generic User-Agent and Accept headers; no AI training.
bias_risks: Community tags are subjective, non-authoritative annotations, not official MTG Oracle mechanics
Inconsistent granularity across card types
sources.status_rationale: Official Scryfall 'Oracle Tags' bulk export is accessible (access_status=ok_with_conditions, no longer blocked on license); data quality remains REVIEW due to community tag subjectivity.

sources.title: Archidekt Public Decklists
sources.observation_period: Historical Chulane bracket decklists in local corpus (723 decks)
sources.coverage_scope: Public Commander decklists with optional bracket metadata
sources.double_counting_risk: Decks indexed by Archidekt overlap with EDHREC decklists; deduplicate by canonical oracle_id fingerprint.
sources.license_terms: Archidekt Terms of Service (effective 2018-09-07): same wording as EDHREC; personal use only, automated queries and scripts prohibited; no public API documentation.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: PROHIBITED_AUTOMATED_RETRIEVAL (Terms of Service prohibit automated queries/scripts; no public API documentation).
bias_risks: Deckbuilding popularity != gameplay strength
Self-reported bracket tags may be inconsistent across authors
sources.status_rationale: No authorized automated retrieval path; Terms of Service (2018-09-07) prohibit automated queries with the same wording as EDHREC.

sources.title: Moxfield Public Decklists
sources.coverage_scope: Not collected directly; API host disallowed
sources.double_counting_risk: Decks hosted on Moxfield overlap with EDHREC aggregations.
sources.license_terms: api2.moxfield.com/robots.txt disallows all paths (User-agent: * / Disallow: /); moxfield.com/terms returns HTTP 403 to automated clients.
bias_risks: Deckbuilding popularity != gameplay strength
Direct automated access blocked
sources.status_rationale: Automated access blocked: api2.moxfield.com/robots.txt disallows all paths for all user agents.
